correctness.rationale: Every sum-two bin has an integer split k between edges 02 and loops 11, reducing the observation exactly to undirected multigraph Euler trails/circuits. Linear parity is automatic on three vertices and only three disconnected-support cases must be removed. For cyclic words all degrees must be even; the four disjoint parity/connectivity cases are exhaustive and each has a constructive split. Their exact series simplifies to the rational expression; the coefficient formula and leading terms follow by partial fractions. Independently, explicit source-word enumeration checks 118,092 inputs, all 3,478,760 five-bin histograms up to read length fifty are counted, and Euler witness construction checks 12,286 realizable instances. Finite computations are corroboration only. The proof includes the length-one cyclic loop and all nonempty lengths.

value.rationale: The natural five-bin aggregate of adjacent integer masses loses the distinction between a middle-symbol loop and an outer-symbol pair, so its exact image size is not a relabeling of six-bin profile counting. The result gives complete all-length feasibility, sharp finite-block zero-error capacities in two read models, and a mathematically motivated asymptotic 1/2 closure law. These quantities measure a real ambiguity of the specified low-resolution observation map and provide baseline codebook bounds, without implying noisy-channel or laboratory performance.
